review:
Road Rage is a traffic-jam slot on a 3-4-3-4-3-4-3 grid where every car is a wild with its own colour-coded effect. For example, the yellow Engine Breakdown car enlarges the other symbols.

Three scatters trigger Morning Rush, four H1ghway Jam and five City Mayh3m, and a Rage Buff boosts each bonus before it starts. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 36,000x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
